title: Public benefits ‘cliffs’ can trap low-wage workers, study finds
summary_en: New research from Washington University in St. Louis argues that policymakers should enact gradual cutoffs for public benefits such as food assistance or healthcare. The change could help both families and employers by allowing low-wage workers to earn more without losing critical support systems.
title_cn: Public benefits ‘cliffs’ can trap low-wage workers, study finds

title: Malone installed as Nancy and Kenneth Kranzberg Curator
summary_en: Meredith Malone was installed as the Nancy and Kenneth Kranzberg Curator at the WashU Kemper Art Museum May 18. The endowed position is the museum’s first named curatorship.
title_cn: Malone installed as Nancy and Kenneth Kranzberg Curator

title: Building better workplaces for an aging workforce
summary_en: As Americans work longer than previous generations, employers have an opportunity to create workplaces that support employees of all ages, according to a new article by Cal Halvorsen, associate professor at the WashU Brown School.
title_cn: Building better workplaces for an aging workforce
